_说明: 34 个镜头。from=首帧、to=尾帧，motion 是提示词里唯一变化的那一句。完整提示词 = style_line + motion + tail。
_镜长分配: plan = [旁白句id, [镜id...], 权重]，权重 null 表示平均分。某镜时长 =（该句配音时长 + 气口）× 权重。三处不平均分：开场 62/38 给第一个画面看清的时间；天平 40/60 让「钱越堆越高」那镜更长；结尾 35/65 留 4.5 秒收尾。
style_line: Monochrome archival black-and-white print on cool ivory paper, matte halftone texture, flat even light. One muted brick crimson accent only. Everything is a real physical object, never a chart or diagram.
tail: One continuous transformation, no cuts, no camera shake. No subtitles, no captions, no watermark.

shots.motion: The camera pulls back and the vast crowd shrinks into a small photographic print lying on bare paper, while a white paper sticker slides in and settles beside it.
The camera pushes in hard on the sticker until it fills the centre of the frame, as dense printed ledger columns crowd in from every side.
The ledger columns fold away and a huge mechanical split-flap board rises into place, its flaps beginning to clatter over.
The flaps clatter to a stop row by row until the whole board is still and the top row is legible.
The board recedes and two heavy stone pedestal steps slide in from either side, the right one rising until it stands far taller than the left.
The stone steps sink away and a hand comes in from the right, fingers closing on the corner of the sticker.
The hand peels the sticker fully off and carries it out of frame, leaving only its pale adhesive ghost on the paper.
A large old printed world map unrolls across the frame from the left, covering the bare paper completely, its corners settling flat.
Hundreds of small black memory chips rain down and scatter loose all across the surface of the map.
Three hands sweep in across the map and rake the scattered chips into three big dense piles, leaving only a few strays behind.
The camera pushes in on the Korean peninsula as a crimson map pin is driven into the paper, its paper tag swinging.
A second crimson map pin is driven in beside the first, its paper tag swinging to rest.
The camera pulls back off the peninsula to take in the whole map as a third crimson pin lands in the western United States.
The camera slides across the map away from the pins and the chip piles, settling on eastern China where there is nothing at all but one small empty pin hole.
The camera pushes right in to the empty pin hole until it fills the frame, and a blank paper tag slides into view beside it.
The map and tag slide away and an old brass balance scale rises into the frame, one chip settling onto its left pan and a few coins onto the right.
Coin after coin stacks up on the right pan until the pile towers high, and the beam never tilts, staying dead level throughout.
The balance sinks out of frame and the map returns, the camera settling on eastern China as a thumb presses a crimson pin into it for the first time.
The thumb withdraws and a small folded paper factory building rises up out of the map beside the pin, unfolding to full height.
The map folds away and a flight of three stone steps slides in, a single black chip and its label card landing on the lowest step.
A second chip and label card drop onto the middle step and settle.
A third chip and label card drop onto the top step and settle.
The steps sink away as hundreds of loose black chips pour across the paper into one great heap, and a hand with tweezers reaches into it.
The tweezers lift chip after chip out of the heap and set them aside into a small separate handful, a label card sliding in beside it.
The heap clears away and a stepped podium of four blocks slides in, the small handful of chips consolidating into one chip standing on the lowest block.
The podium slides out of frame and a thick document settles down into the centre of the paper.
A round crimson seal stamp descends from above and presses firmly down onto the document cover.
The stamp lifts away leaving a wet crimson ring, and a thin crimson line runs out of it toward the right.
The document slides away and a mechanical split-flap price board rises into place, its digits beginning to clatter over.
The digits clatter upward faster and faster then snap to a halt, the board holding one final number.
The board recedes and small pale paper slips begin to fall through the frame from above.
The slips pour down in enormous quantity and pile up until they cover the whole page.
The drift of slips slides away toward the frame edges, uncovering the stone podium standing beneath it.
The camera pulls steadily back and around, revealing that the podium continues upward well past the occupied blocks into taller empty ones.
